theory_content: Support is a zone where demand often steps in and price tends to stop falling. Resistance is a zone where supply often appears and price tends to stop rising. Traders use repeated reactions at these zones to plan entries, exits, and stop-loss levels.

A trendline breakout happens when price closes beyond a well-tested trendline with strong participation. A valid breakout is usually confirmed by volume expansion and follow-through, not by a single intraday spike.

Head and Shoulders is a potential trend reversal pattern with three peaks: left shoulder, higher head, and right shoulder. The neckline break is the trigger. Inverse Head and Shoulders is the bullish version.

A Double Top forms when price fails twice near the same high and then breaks down. A Double Bottom forms when price rebounds twice near the same low and then breaks up. Confirmation comes after the middle swing level breaks.
